key_insight: Ultrasonic nanocrystal surface modification substantially boosts the hardness and wear resistance of WC–Co–Cr thermal spray coatings, with the best result depending on the failure mode considered.
engineering_relevance: Combining thermal spraying with UNSM is a practical route to extend the service life of steel components exposed to abrasion, erosion, cavitation, and corrosion.
method: Deposited WC–Co–Cr coatings by detonation spraying (DS), HVOF, and APS
Applied ultrasonic nanocrystal surface modification (UNSM) to each coating type
Evaluated microstructure, hardness, friction, wear, cavitation, corrosion, oxidation, and valve endurance
evidence_signal: The abstract reports clear performance gains after UNSM, including hardness up to 1596 HV and the lowest wear metrics for APS + UNSM, while HVOF + UNSM performed best in valve endurance.
watch_item: The optimal coating is application-specific, so no single spray process plus UNSM combination is universally best across all degradation mechanisms.
paper_title: Ultrasonic Surface Modification of WC-Co-Cr Thermal Spray Coatings: Microstructure, Mechanical Properties and Performance
